top_choice_rationale: DMFT's limiting foundation and dynamical mapping remain my strongest foundational many-body achievement, with Georges, Vollhardt and Kotliar representing a coherent proposed original construction. The citation does not promise exact real-material solutions: discriminating spectra and nonlocal limitations are essential to its physical meaning. Force microscopy is my closest available structural-access rival, but its sensor-plus-tip common history remains less settled; clocks offer a narrow cancellation invention. The bounded statistical-relations and circuit-interaction cases also merit recognition above no award, while requiring their own original-credit and scope review.
recusal_note: None apparent from my supplied profile. My Uppsala and Los Alamos connections and listed coauthors establish no direct relationship to the proposed laureates. Correlated-materials and electronic-structure work informs this judgment without itself establishing a candidate-specific conflict; any later concrete tie would need independent assessment.
